sections.title:
Drive Thru: -	 
 -	Pour 2 large Coca-Cola, with NO Ice, and discard.  
 -  Pour a 3rd large Coca- Cola with NO Ice  
 -   Place thermometer in the middle and slowly stir until the temperature reading is stable.    
 -	Stop stirring and record temperature.  	
    If 36 or less – Gold Standard.
    If 37 degrees or higher. Please review best practices and notify the  manager to take corrective action.

Second Dispenser:
 -	If there is a second beverage dispenser, select type from ONE of the two temperature readings below (Self Serve or 2nd ABS)
 -	Pour 2 large Coca-Cola, with NO Ice, and discard. 
 -  Pour a 3rd large Coca- Cola with NO Ice. 
-   Place thermometer in the middle and slowly stir until the temperature reading is stable.    
-	Stop stirring and record temperature. 
	If 36 or less – Gold Standard.  
    If 37 degrees or higher. Please review best practices and notify the  manager to take corrective action.
